title: Multiple Explosions Rock Erbil Near US Consulate As Iranian Drones Hit Iraq
content: Several explosions rocked Erbil in northern Iraq early Tuesday, including near the US Consulate, as Iranian drones targeted multiple locations across the region.

title: Seattle Shooting: 15-Year-Old Arrested, Cops Say 3 Shooters Involved
content: Police said Monday there were at least three suspects involved in a shootout at a crowded food festival near Seattle's Space Needle over the weekend. One of them was among those killed in the violence.

title: US, India Expanding Defence, Civil Nuclear Cooperation: Trump Official
content: The US and India are expanding defence and civil nuclear cooperation, including the adoption of trusted AI and other emerging technologies powering the economy, US Assistant Secretary of State S Paul Kapur said.

title: Supreme Court: No bail in digital arrest cases barring exceptional grounds
content: apex court says it is against grant of bail to anyone accused of being part of digital arrest scams . the bench of cJI Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana said digital arrests are the 'worst kind of crime against people'
